n: The 1291L 12" Open Frame Touchscreen Display with TouchPro from Elo
d: The 1291L 12" Open Frame Touchscreen Display with TouchPro from Elo Touch is an industrial-grade monitor with a high-brightness, wide viewing angle LCD with an LED backlight.

specs.label: Touch Technology & Capacity
specs.value: SAW (IntelliTouch® Surface Acoustic Wave) - Single Touch; PCAP (TouchPro® Projected Capacitive) - 10 Touch

specs.label: Touch Interface
specs.value: TouchPro PCAP - USB 2.0 ; IntelliTouch - Dual serial/USB 2.0

specs.label: On Screen Display
specs.value: Accessible through switches on the unit’s tethered OSD Control box.

specs.label: Viewing Angle
specs.value: Horizontal: ±88° or 176° total / Vertical: ±88° or 176° total

specs.label: Brightness (typical)
specs.value: LCD panel: 450 nits ; IntelliTouch: 405 nits ; TouchPro PCAP: 405 nits
